restoration_timing: Train normally from pristine. For development and test separately, reset neural activity and restore the saved training memory, then reset incoming weights/u/w of the declared target cells to pristine. Freeze all plasticity and omit reinforcement throughout each inference phase. Development state is never carried into test.
hypothesis: Repeat the same five-arm restoration comparison on the next chronological window. Study 06 showed one unselected test-only benefit from restoring 11402, while every arm failed development. Retain every arm and both original pools to test whether that observation persists without selecting from test results.
selection: Choose by development equity only, requiring improvement over both cash and pristine frozen. Evaluate the selected variant once on the subsequent test; show all arms for audit, with no test-based reselection or automatic deployment.
limitations: Small fixed cohort and indicative DEX costs. This is a consecutive-window replication; registration precedes its development and test intervals. No monthly or live-profit claim.
